blocks.text: A quieter townhome on the peninsula

parts.t: Many people looking at these homes already live on the Semiahmoo Peninsula. They have a house in Ocean Park, Sunnyside, Elgin or Morgan Creek and want less yard work without moving away from their friends, their doctor and the beach walk they've done for years.

Townhomes with age-restriction bylaws come up in many parts of the peninsula. Listings have included homes at The Crescent on the Crescent Beach side, St. Martin's Lane and Bishop's Green in central South Surrey, and complexes such as Peninsula Village, Ocean Crest Cottages, The Carrington and The Greens. That doesn't mean every unit in those complexes shows up here, or that a given complex has an age bylaw today. The live list checks each listing's bylaw flag instead.
Many complexes handle roofs, siding and landscaping through the strata, but what's covered changes from complex to complex.

South Surrey is the southern part of the City of Surrey. White Rock is its own city, with Surrey on the west, north and east and Semiahmoo Bay to the south. North Bluff Road, also called 16 Avenue, is the line between the two cities, so a move from one side to the other usually keeps you close to the same shops, clinics and walking routes.

Townhome complexes are spread across the peninsula rather than grouped in one spot. Just north of North Bluff Road, Surrey's Semiahmoo Town Centre runs up the 152 Street corridor, with shops and services around Semiahmoo Mall. On the White Rock side, the Town Centre sits uptown and the Waterfront Village runs along the bay below. If you plan to drive less, check the walk to the nearest bus stop and grocery store before you book a showing. For a closer look by area, see my

blocks.text: How the age bylaw works in BC

parts.t: A strata corporation in BC can pass a bylaw requiring one or more people living in a strata lot to be at least a set age, and that age can't be lower than 55 (
Strata Property Act, section 123.1
). Section 123.2 lists people the bylaw doesn't cover, such as someone already living in the unit before the bylaw passed, and some caregivers. Owners can change bylaws by vote.

The flag on MLS® is entered by the listing agent. It doesn't tell you the exact age, whether it covers one resident or all of them, or how the strata enforces it. Before you write an offer, read the strata bylaws and the Form B Information Certificate. I can request both for any townhome on this page.

blocks.text: What to check on a townhome strata

parts.t: The bylaw wording.
Read the registered bylaws, not just the listing remarks. Note the stated age, who it covers, and any rules about guests or caregivers.
Form B Information Certificate.
It shows strata fees, any approved special levies and the contingency reserve fund balance.
Minutes and the depreciation report.
Recent minutes show what owners are talking about: roofs, windows, plumbing, or a vote on a bylaw change.
Exterior upkeep.
Find out who pays for decks, fences, garage doors and small yards, since townhome stratas split this in different ways.
Pets and parking.
Check pet limits, visitor parking and whether the garage fits your car.

blocks.text: South Surrey & White Rock 55+ Townhome FAQs

parts.t: What is a 55+ townhome in South Surrey and White Rock?

On this page it means a townhome in South Surrey or White Rock whose MLS® listing is marked with an age-restriction bylaw. BC stratas can require one or more residents to be at least a set age, not lower than 55.
Are the complexes named on this page age-restricted?

Not necessarily. Listings have included homes in The Crescent, St. Martin's Lane, Bishop's Green, Peninsula Village and others, but this page does not claim any complex is age-restricted. Bylaws can change by vote.
How do I confirm a complex's age bylaw?
Ask for the registered strata bylaws and the Form B Information Certificate, and read recent minutes. I can request these for any listing before you write an offer.
Does the bylaw apply to everyone living in the home?

It depends on the wording. A bylaw may require one resident or every resident to meet the age. Under section 123.2 of the Strata Property Act, some people are exempt, such as a resident who lived there before the bylaw passed and some caregivers.
Why does the list change so often?
The listings come from MLS® and update daily. Homes sell, new ones are listed, and the age flag is entered by each listing agent, so use the live list rather than a complex name alone.
Can you help me sell my house and buy a 55+ townhome?
Yes. Most buyers on this page are also selling. Start with a free home evaluation, then call or text me at 604-928-1361 to plan the timing of both moves.
Are there 55+ townhomes with the main bedroom on the main floor?
Some listings have a main-floor bedroom and others have stairs to every bedroom. Check the floor plan on each listing, and ask me to confirm the layout before you book a showing.
